hook: Tsinghua lab open-sources a roughly $21 wrist camera
hookText: Tsinghua lab open-sources a roughly $21 wrist camera

beats.say: A Tsinghua IEI Lab team built a wrist-mounted 1080p camera for the xArm7 from an SC3336 sensor, a Luckfox Pico Mini RV1103 board and a 3D-printed mount, and open-sourced the CAD.
Close-up wrist views are a staple of manipulation datasets, so a sub-$25 build lowers the cost of data collection for robot-learning labs.
0.24 × $ANT stock price = a wrist camera for your xArm, ready to explore agentic AI workflows with Codex / Claude Code!
